procedure.method: Fresh independent critic in this turn; no spawn, resume, fork, peer review, producer inspection, or unlisted path read. Read the pinned packet, case, rules, rubric, addendum and compact method/adapter. Verified exact input hashes/byte counts and read all five pinned native-evidence manifests without following their embedded paths. The packet declares zero source assets and zero protected layouts. Sequentially opened and visually inspected the exact files using tools.view_image with detail original, forwarding each returned image to this session: R15-C1-M1 native/usage720/thumbnail320, then M2, M3, M4, M5 in the same three-view order. All fifteen images were actually displayed before beginning any copy-reading/transcription, judgment or score. Then read each image's eleven entries in packet order from the displayed pixels, retaining soft wraps and meaningful word spaces. No OCR, generated assets, resized replacements or copy inferred from required text. No genuine unresolved glyph-class ambiguity required a revisit. Actual image headers and manifest/packet dimensions agree; each usage image is 720x405, each thumbnail 320x180, all RGB. Native 1672x940 for M1 and 1672x941 for M2-M5 are rounded 16:9, not mathematically exact; abs(height-width*9/16)=0.5 in every case. This is one independent portfolio judgment, not a three-critic aggregate.
